updates.content:
Title: Users may see delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports

User impact: Users may see delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports.

Current status: Our monitoring systems have identified impact for users in the North America and Europe regions, where affected users may see delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports. We’ve identified an upstream delay within the Microsoft 365 Copilot service that’s affecting usage and adoption reporting. We’re investigating the delay to determine its underlying cause and isolate an appropriate remediation action. We’ll provide a resolution timeline once available.

Scope of impact: Impact may occur for users in North America and Europe, where affected users may see delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports.

Next update by: Monday, August 31, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may see delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports

User impact: Users may have seen delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports.

Final status: We've resolved the impacting delays in the upstream pipeline and restarted several report generation processes. After monitoring to ensure that the stalled reports processed and that new usage and adoption reports were being generated as expected, we've confirmed that the service availability has been fully restored.

Scope of impact: Impact may have occurred for users in North America and Europe, where affected users may have seen delayed data in Microsoft 365 Copilot usage and adoption reports.

Start time: Friday, August 28, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC

End time: Sunday, August 30, 2026, at 1:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A delay within the upstream data processing pipeline resulted in subsequent delays generating usage and adoption reports

Next steps: - We're continuing to streamline the data processing flow to ensure robust service availability and effectively meet increasing user demand.
